title: Tailr Core plugin
description: plugin.json of a Tailr Core plugin. See docs/plugins-maken.md.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion in your editor.

id.description: Unique id; must equal the folder name. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: Version of the plugin (semver, e.g. 1.2.0). Raise it on every change.

api.description: The plugin API this plugin needs, as "major.minor" (e.g. "1.0"). Use the lowest version that has everything you use; see "Plugin API versions" in docs/plugins.md.

requires.description: What must be present for this plugin to load.

core.description: A version range for Tailr Core itself (rarely needed; prefer api).

plugins.description: Plugins that must be installed, with a version range, e.g. { "tools": ">=1.0" }. Use them with api.use.

optional.description: Plugins this plugin can do more with, but does not need.

plugins.description: Plugins this plugin uses when they are installed, with a version range.

title.description: Name in the catalogue: a string, or per language { "nl": "…", "en": "…" }. Give both Dutch and English.

summary.description: One sentence for the catalogue: a string, or { "nl": "…", "en": "…" }.

entry.description: The file that exports register(api). Default index.ts.

hooks.description: For the catalogue: where the plugin hooks in, e.g. "guard tool.before", "screen" or "tool".

onFailure.description: After 5 failures in a row: "disable" turns the plugin off (default); "block" keeps it on so its guards keep refusing (for security plugins).
